specification.known_exposure: All2024/25–2025/26league outcomes and prior aggregate metrics were inspected in the20260907cycle. This cycle freezes new hypotheses before their evaluation but is not a pristine test.

selection.rule: lowest pooled natural-log loss among six candidates; retain prior selected blend when no candidate beats it; fixed candidate ID tie-break

specification.timing: forecast at each league local00:00, historical final result/statistics available next local midnight; same-day update forbidden; known resumption source-completion-day exception inherited
specification.base_refit: same first forecast day of calendar two-month bucket and same prior1095local-calendar-day rows as previous cycle
specification.production_default_definition: Exact current default equal DC fitted to production chronological_populations.fit, auto calibration on disjoint.calibration, frozen until next research refit; verify against actual run_prediction API. Production cadence/history input controlled to same1095days and two-month cadence as comparators. No claim that stronger prior research is production.
specification.parent_hyperparameters: All prior DC and Elo settings unchanged; same historical data and timing.

shot_strength_model.type: ridge Poisson GLM for shots and shots-on-target, each with additive team attack/opponent defence and home flag; count mean features, not an xG model

offset_model.objective: mean negative log likelihood + penalty/2 * sum(W**2), including correction intercept; W=0 is exact prior identity
offset_model.training: strictly prior available prequential base predictions/outcomes from all3leagues, trailing1460calendar days; scalers fit on these same rows; no in-sample base probabilities
offset_model.pooling: Historical meta-learning includes all3leagues; evaluation is chronological country/year transfer, not zero-shot held-out league transfer

uncertainty.interval: percentile95, historical conditional uncertainty; no adjustment for researcher reuse

specification.substantial_gain_target: At least2% lower pooled evaluation log loss than BOTH predeclared strong research references, plus improvement over current production default; paired28-day interval should exclude zero against both research references. Failure to meet this target is reported, without expanding the search.
limitations: shots data are final post-match observations used only in future forecasts
